---
title: "02_clean"
format: html
---

Library
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("fs")
library("janitor")
```

Load the unclean data
```{r}
unclean_data <- read_tsv(file = "../data/01_dat_load.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

Inspecting the data
```{r}
unclean_data |> 
  view() |>
  spec()
```

Change the metric system for weight to European
```{r}
unclean_data <- unclean_data |>
  mutate(weight = round(weight * 0.45359237, 1))
```

Inspecting columns
```{r}
names(unclean_data)
```

Removing insignificant columns
```{r}
unclean_data <- unclean_data %>% select(-rownames, -ptid, -mridate)
```

Inspect race values
```{r}
unique(unclean_data$race)
class(unclean_data$race)
levels(unclean_data$race)
```

Check for NAs
```{r}
unclean_data <- unclean_data |> 
  mutate(
    race = na_if(
      race,
      "Subject did not identify as White, Black or Asian")
    ) 

unclean_data |> 
  summarise(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~sum(is.na(.x))
    )
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "column",
    values_to = "n_missing"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    percent_missing = round(
      100 * n_missing / nrow(unclean_data),
      1
    )
  )

```

Discard rows with NAs 
```{r}
unclean_data <- unclean_data |>
  drop_na()
```

Looking into the dataset after cleaning
```{r}
unclean_data |>
  view()
```

Saving the clean data
```{r}
write_tsv(x = unclean_data, file = "../data/02_dat_clean.tsv")
```
